title: openEHR Demographic Information Model
description: OOJS representation of the openEHR RM demographic specification (RM Release 1.0.3). Covers the single demographic package containing all party, role, identity, contact, address, capability, and actor types.

PARTY_IDENTITY.description: An identity owned by a PARTY, such as a person's legal name, stage name, alias, or a company's trading name. The inherited name attribute carries the purpose of the identity (e.g. 'legal', 'nickname'). Actual structure is archetyped via details.

details.description: The value of the identity, typically a parsable string or small structure of strings. Archetyped.

ADDRESS.description: An address of contact, which may be electronic (e-mail, phone) or geographic (postal, physical). The inherited name attribute carries the address type (e.g. 'electronic', 'locality'). Actual structure is archetyped via details.

CONTACT.description: A means of contacting a party for a specific purpose and optional time period. The inherited name attribute carries the purpose (e.g. 'mail', 'daytime phone'). Contains one or more ADDRESS alternatives for that purpose.

addresses.description: One or more address alternatives for this contact purpose and time validity.

time_validity.description: Optional valid time interval for this contact descriptor.

CAPABILITY.description: A capability of a ROLE, such as 'EHR modifier' or 'health care provider', backed by credentials. The inherited name attribute carries the capability name.

credentials.description: Qualifications of the role performer for this capability: professional qualifications, provider numbers, etc. Archetyped.

time_validity.description: Optional valid time interval for the credentials of this capability.

PARTY_RELATIONSHIP.description: A directed relationship between two parties. The source party stores the relationship by value; the target party holds only a back-reference. The inherited name attribute carries the relationship type (e.g. 'employment', 'patient'). Actual details are archetyped.

source.description: Reference to the Version container of the source party.

target.description: Reference to the Version container of the target party.

details.description: Optional archetyped detailed description of the relationship.

time_validity.description: Optional valid time interval for this relationship.

PARTY.description: Abstract ancestor of all party types: real-world entities (ACTORs) and their roles (ROLEs). The inherited name attribute indicates the party type (e.g. 'PERSON', 'ORGANISATION') or role name. The uid is redefined as HIER_OBJECT_ID to identify the Version container of this party. Must be an archetype root point.

identities.description: Identities used by the party to identify itself: legal names, aliases, stage names, etc.

contacts.description: Optional contact descriptors for this party.

details.description: Optional archetyped additional details for this party, including state-issued identifiers.

relationships.description: Optional relationships in which this party participates as source. Stored by value.

reverse_relationships.description: Optional references to relationships in which this party participates as target. Stored by reference.

ROLE.description: A role performed by an ACTOR, corresponding to a competency or responsibility undertaken for a purpose. Roles should have credentials (via CAPABILITY) qualifying the performer. The uid identifies the Version container of this role.

performer.description: Reference to the Version container of the ACTOR playing this role.

capabilities.description: Optional capabilities of this role, each backed by credentials.

time_validity.description: Optional valid time interval for this role.

ACTOR.description: Abstract ancestor of all real-world entity types: PERSON, ORGANISATION, GROUP, AGENT. An actor is any real-world entity capable of taking on a role.

languages.description: Languages which can be used to communicate with this actor, in preferred order of use.

roles.description: References to the Version containers of each ROLE played by this actor.

PERSON.description: Generic description of a person. Provides a dedicated concrete type to which Person archetypes can be targeted. All person-specific attributes (name, date of birth, sex, identifiers, etc.) are expressed via archetyped PARTY.details and PARTY_IDENTITY.details.

ORGANISATION.description: Generic description of an organisation: a legally constituted body whose existence generally outlives the existence of parties considered to be part of it. All organisation-specific attributes are expressed via archetyped PARTY.details.

GROUP.description: A real-world group of parties created by another party (usually an organisation) for a specific purpose, e.g. a specialist care team. Members typically work together. All group-specific attributes are expressed via archetyped PARTY.details.

AGENT.description: Any kind of agent other than a human or organisation: devices, software systems, automated processes. All agent-specific attributes are expressed via archetyped PARTY.details.
